posts.title: 🎓 Moving Up Ceremony — Thursday, June 26
posts.body: Harlem 1 families, please join us Thursday, June 26 at 10:00 AM in the cafeteria to celebrate our 4th-grade scholars moving up to middle school! Doors open at 9:40. Each scholar may bring up to 4 guests. A reception follows. Scholars should wear their full Success Academy uniform.
posts.bodyEs: Familias de Harlem 1, acompáñennos el jueves 26 de junio a las 10:00 AM en la cafetería para celebrar a nuestros estudiantes de 4.º grado que pasan a la escuela intermedia. Las puertas abren a las 9:40. Cada estudiante puede traer hasta 4 invitados. Los estudiantes deben usar el uniforme completo de Success Academy.

posts.title: ♟️ Chess Team takes 2nd at the NYC Scholastic Championship!
posts.body: Incredibly proud of our Harlem 1 Chess Team! Out of 40 schools, our scholars placed 2nd overall and Aanya Sharma earned a top-10 individual board prize. Practices continue through the summer program. Thank you to every family who got scholars to Saturday tournaments all year. ♟️🏆
posts.bodyEs: ¡Estoy muy orgullosa de nuestro Equipo de Ajedrez de Harlem 1! De 40 escuelas, nuestros estudiantes quedaron en 2.º lugar y Aanya Sharma ganó un premio individual entre los 10 mejores.

comments.body: Aanya was SO excited — thank you Ms. Petrov!
Best chess program in the city 🏆

posts.title: Cornell's End-of-Year Read-a-Thon 📚 — 1,412 books!
posts.body: What a year of readers! Cornell read 1,412 books together this year. Next Wednesday we celebrate with a "book tasting" — scholars rotate through chapters of summer reading picks. If you can donate individually-wrapped snacks, there's a sign-up. Aanya, Mateo, and Tyler all reached Reading Level R — tremendous growth! 🌟
posts.bodyEs: ¡Qué año de lectores! Cornell leyó 1,412 libros juntos este año. El próximo miércoles celebraremos con una "degustación de libros". Aanya, Mateo y Tyler alcanzaron el nivel de lectura R.

comments.body: Aanya has not stopped talking about this! 📚
¡Gracias Sr. Bell por todo este año!
Tyler read more this year than I did 😅

posts.title: Summer STEM Academy — Registration Now Open (network-wide)
posts.body: Success Academy Summer STEM Academy runs July 7–Aug 1 for rising 1st–8th grade scholars. Free for all enrolled families; includes breakfast & lunch. Mornings focus on reading & math; afternoons on hands-on science, chess, and sports. Space is limited — complete the registration form by June 30. Bus transportation available on existing routes.
posts.bodyEs: La Academia STEM de Verano de Success Academy se realiza del 7 de julio al 1 de agosto para estudiantes de 1.º a 8.º grado. Gratis para todas las familias inscritas; incluye desayuno y almuerzo.

posts.title: 🔬 K–4 Science Expo — Photos!
posts.body: Thank you to everyone who came to our Science Expo! Scholars presented investigations from a full year of hands-on science — from "sink or float" in Kindergarten to electric circuits in 4th grade. Swipe through a few highlights. Your scholar's work may be featured!

comments.body: Found Aanya's circuit board — she was beaming! 🔌

posts.title: June Lunch Menu + Free/Reduced Meal Forms
posts.body: The June lunch menu is attached. Reminder: complete your Free/Reduced Meal Benefit form for next school year — it unlocks meal benefits AND helps Success Academy qualify for additional funding. Takes 3 minutes; it's in your Forms tab. Uniform reminder: scholars need orange polos + navy bottoms through the last day.

posts.title: Lost & Found overflowing — please check before June 27
posts.body: Our Lost & Found is overflowing with uniform sweaters, water bottles, and lunchboxes! Please stop by the front lobby before the last day. Everything remaining on June 27 will be donated. Labeled items will be sent home with scholars.

posts.title: 🎨 Spring Art Show — what a turnout!
posts.body: Over 300 families came through our Spring Art Show. Scholars displayed self-portraits, clay sculptures, and a collaborative mural. So proud of every young artist — prints available soon!
posts.bodyEs: Más de 300 familias asistieron a nuestra Exposición de Arte de Primavera. ¡Estoy muy orgullosa de cada joven artista!

posts.title: Cornell at the Museum of Natural History 🦕
posts.body: Cornell had a blast at the American Museum of Natural History! We studied ecosystems, marveled at the blue whale, and sketched dinosaur skeletons. Thank you to our chaperones — we couldn't do these trips without you.
posts.bodyEs: ¡Cornell la pasó genial en el Museo de Historia Natural! Gracias a nuestros acompañantes.

comments.body: ¡Mateo no para de hablar del museo!
Tyler drew the T-rex all weekend 🦖

posts.title: 🧡 Spirit Day was a blast!
posts.body: Our halls were buzzing for Spirit Day — scholars showed up with energy, pride, and a whole lot of orange. Thank you to the Family Council for the cheer tunnel at arrival!
posts.bodyEs: ¡Nuestros pasillos se llenaron de energía y orgullo en el Día del Espíritu Escolar!

posts.title: ⚽ Strikers season + Field Day prep
posts.body: Our after-school Strikers had a fantastic season and Field Day is almost here! Scholars: bring sneakers and a labeled water bottle. Parents: we still need a few volunteers at the relay station.
posts.bodyEs: ¡Nuestros Strikers tuvieron una gran temporada y el Día de Campo ya casi llega! Buscamos voluntarios.

posts.title: A peek into Kindergarten 🌱
posts.body: Our youngest scholars have grown so much — from morning meeting on the rug to reading their very first books. A little look at the joy in our K classrooms.
posts.bodyEs: Nuestros estudiantes más pequeños han crecido muchísimo. Aquí un vistazo a la alegría en nuestras aulas de Kínder.

posts.title: 🌟 Scholars of the Month
posts.body: Congratulations to our Scholars of the Month for exceptional focus and kindness to classmates. We are so proud of you!
posts.bodyEs: ¡Felicitaciones a nuestros Estudiantes del Mes! Estamos muy orgullosos de ustedes.

messages.body: Hi Abhinav — here's the Family Connect prototype: a ParentSquare-style family-engagement app for Success Academy. Tap the avatar (top-right) to switch personas — admin, teacher, and parent (including a Spanish-speaking family) — to see every side of the platform. Try creating an event, setting up conference sign-ups, or sending an alert (it'll buzz your phone). Everything is fictional data and runs on-device. Happy to walk you through it.
Hi Mr. Bell! Aanya mentioned a book tasting next week — does she need to bring anything?

Hi Priya! Nothing required — just her smile 😊 If you'd like to donate individually-wrapped snacks there's an optional sign-up in the Cornell post. Aanya has had a fantastic year — and congrats on the chess prize!
That's wonderful to hear. I'll grab a slot for pretzels. Thank you for everything this year!
Perfect, pretzels are claimed 🥨 See you at the Moving Up ceremony!
¿Mateo necesita traer su proyecto de lectura mañana?
messages.bodyEn: Does Mateo need to bring his reading project tomorrow?

messages.body: Yes please — tomorrow is fine. He did a great job on it!
messages.bodyEs: Sí, por favor — mañana está bien. ¡Hizo un trabajo excelente!

messages.bodyEn: Thank you! It will be ready.

messages.body: Hi Ms. Sharma — Rohan's updated immunization record is due before the first day next year. You can upload it in the Emergency & Health form. Let me know if you need help!
Thanks Nurse Murphy — our pediatrician visit is July 9, I'll upload right after.
Hi all! A few of us want to organize a class gift for Mr. Bell. Thinking a bookstore gift card — contribute what you can. I'll collect by Wed.
¡Me apunto! ¿A quién le envío el dinero?
messages.bodyEn: I'm in! Who do I send the money to?

messages.body: I'll DM payment info so it stays a surprise 🤫

alerts.title: Early Dismissal Today — 12:00 PM (Heat Advisory)
alerts.body: Due to a citywide heat advisory and limited A/C in parts of the building, Harlem 1 will dismiss at 12:00 PM today. Aftercare is canceled. Buses will run on the early schedule. Please arrange pickup. Lunch will be served before dismissal.
alerts.bodyEs: Debido a una advertencia de calor en toda la ciudad, Harlem 1 terminará las clases a las 12:00 PM hoy. El cuidado después de clases está cancelado. Los autobuses funcionarán en el horario temprano.

alerts.title: Heads-up: Scheduled Safety Drill Thursday
alerts.body: This Thursday we will conduct a routine, scheduled lockdown drill at 10 AM. This is a DRILL — there is no threat. We share in advance so you can talk with your scholar. Drills help keep everyone prepared and calm.
alerts.bodyEs: Este jueves realizaremos un simulacro de seguridad de rutina a las 10 AM. Es un SIMULACRO — no hay ninguna amenaza. Lo compartimos con anticipación para que pueda hablar con su estudiante.
